## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Quote file mentions with spaces + normalize Windows separators (tools, ~5h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13402 "Fix code actions failing with 'command not found' on VS Code 1.134" (merged 2026-08-20). Includes fix for @ file mentions breaking on paths with spaces: getFileMentionFromPath now quotes mentions generated by Add to Cline / Fix / Explain / Improve commands when the relative path contains spaces, so the mention regex no longer truncates the path at the first space. Also quotes the path part of workspace-prefixed mentions (workspace:/path with spaces) inserted from @ context menu, which previously bypassed quoting because the value does not start with '/'. Adds posix separator normalization for Windows (toPosixPath) so Windows backslash paths are normalized to forward slashes in mentions for cross-platform consistency. Pattern: quote paths containing spaces (wrap in quotes if path.includes(' ')), normalize Windows separators to posix (path.replace(/\\/g, '/')), apply universally to all file-mention generation sites (code actions, @ context menu, workspace prefixes). User benefit: Add/Fix/Explain/Improve commands work correctly on files with spaces, cross-platform file mentions consistent (Windows paths work in Linux contexts, vice versa).
- **Why**: Alexi generates file mentions in multiple contexts: task suggestions via src/tool/tools/suggest.ts (L120-180: suggests files to edit/read, no quoting logic), diagnostics via src/tool/tools/diagnostics.ts (L100-150: emits file:line references, no space handling), agent-manager PR comments via src/core/agent-manager/ (generates file paths in PR review comments, no quoting audit), bash tool error messages (src/tool/tools/bash.ts L500-550: file paths in error output, no quoting). Cline's #13402 adds universal quoting + posix separator normalization for file mentions containing spaces, preventing truncation at first space and ensuring cross-platform consistency. MODERATE priority: correctness improvement (file mentions with spaces currently break or truncate, common on Windows "Documents and Settings" / "Program Files" paths, macOS "Library/Application Support"), medium complexity (~5h: add quoting helper function `maybeQuoteFilePath(path: string): string` that checks for spaces + special chars and wraps in quotes, add posix separator normalization `toPosixPath` for Windows, audit all file-mention generation sites in suggest.ts / diagnostics.ts / agent-manager / bash.ts / task suggestions / error formatting, apply quoting + normalization universally, add regression tests for paths with spaces + Windows backslash paths). Pattern portable (file-mention generation is universal across tools).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13402 "Fix code actions failing with 'command not found' on VS Code 1.134" (merged 2026-08-20). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13402. Adds getFileMentionFromPath quoting for paths containing spaces, posix separator normalization for Windows, regression test for space-containing paths, fixes #13338.
- **Category**: tools (file mention quoting). **Size**: ~5h (add quoting helper + posix separator normalization, audit all file-mention generation sites, apply universally, regression tests for spaces + Windows backslash paths). **Priority**: MODERATE (correctness improvement, common on Windows + macOS paths with spaces, medium complexity, proven pattern). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-20).

#### 2. Durable todo agenda with scheduled tasks (tools/config, ~8h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13331 "feat: allow agents to create scheduled tasks" (merged 2026-08-20). Adds durable todo agenda with scheduled-task creation/execution. Pattern: tasks tool schema adds schedule field for recurring/one-time tasks (cron-style cadence, "in 5 minutes", "tomorrow at 9am"), workspace-scoped task authority (hub-level registration prevents cross-workspace task execution), serialized approval flow (user must approve task automation before first execution, websocket authentication for approval delivery, broadcast failure cleanup, cancel on broadcast failure), task execution commands guarded by workspace registration (prevent unregistered schedule authority from injecting tasks), tasks persist to .alexi/tasks.json or similar (survives hub restart, CLI relaunch), cron-style scheduler runs in background (checks tasks.json every minute, executes due tasks, records last-run timestamp). User benefit: agents can create follow-up tasks ("run tests in 5 minutes after build finishes", "daily npm audit at 9am", "retry failed command in 30 seconds"), automation reduces manual intervention for routine tasks.
- **Why**: Alexi has todowrite tool (src/tool/tools/todowrite.ts L1-120: creates/updates in-memory todo list for current session, renders in TUI, no persistence beyond session lifecycle, no scheduled execution) but NO scheduled-task capability or persistent agenda. Cline's #13331 adds durable todo agenda with scheduled-task creation/execution — agents can request follow-up tasks ("run tests after build", "daily audit"), automation reduces manual steps, tasks survive hub restart. MODERATE priority: workflow automation improvement (valuable for CI/agent workflows, reduces manual intervention for routine tasks like "retry failed test in 5 minutes" or "daily npm audit"), medium complexity (~8h: add tasks.json persistence layer, cron-style scheduler (runs every minute, checks due tasks, executes via orchestrator), workspace-scoped task authority (hub-level registration), serialized approval flow (user must approve task automation, websocket authentication for approval delivery), task execution commands (guard by workspace registration), hub/CLI integration (scheduler runs in background thread or via background-process tool), test scheduled execution + approval flow + workspace isolation). Pattern portable (background scheduler reuses existing infrastructure, approval flow reuses permission system).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13331 "feat: allow agents to create scheduled tasks" (merged 2026-08-20). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13331. Adds tasks tool with schedule field, workspace-scoped authority, serialized approval flow, websocket authentication, task execution commands, cross-platform path normalization, polynomial regex fix in mention parsing.
- **Category**: tools/config (scheduled tasks). **Size**: ~8h (add tasks.json persistence, cron-style scheduler, workspace-scoped authority, approval flow, hub/CLI integration, test scheduled execution + approval + workspace isolation). **Priority**: MODERATE (workflow automation improvement, valuable for CI/agent workflows, medium complexity, proven pattern). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-20).

#### 3. PowerShell fail-fast error semantics (tools, ~4h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #13358 "fix(shared): run PowerShell commands with fail-fast error semantics" (merged 2026-08-20). Adds fail-fast error semantics to run_commands PowerShell wrapper. Pattern: prepend `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';` to the script content executed by the ScriptBlock (actually set in the -Command bootstrap scope so param(...) blocks stay in first-statement position and error positions stay unshifted), so the first non-terminating error terminates the command with non-zero exit and single error message. Default PowerShell behavior is 'Continue' (emits one error record per item in pipelines like `Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Where-Object { malformed }`, can produce tens of thousands of stderr records on large trees and still resolve SUCCESS with exit 0). Setting Stop promotes every non-terminating error to terminating, so per-item pipeline floods stop at first error. Tradeoff: partial-result commands (recursive listings over access-denied junctions) now stop at first error instead of skipping denied entries, Windows PowerShell 5.1 in-script stderr redirection of succeeding native commands may become fatal. Precedent: GitHub Actions sets `$ErrorActionPreference = 'stop'` by default. Opt-outs: per-command `-ErrorAction Continue` or `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`. User benefit: PowerShell errors fail immediately with single message, no more tens of thousands of stderr records on malformed pipelines, exit codes reflect actual failure.
- **Why**: Alexi bash tool (src/tool/tools/bash.ts L230-255: detectShell + shellSpawnArgs dispatches to PowerShell via src/tool/tools/shell/id.ts L80-120 `{ file: 'powershell.exe', prefixArgs: ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command'] }` on Windows when $SHELL or %ComSpec% is PowerShell, command passed as single string after -Command flag) does NOT set `$ErrorActionPreference`. Malformed PowerShell pipelines (e.g. `Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Where-Object { invalid syntax }`) emit one error record per enumerated file — tens of thousands of stderr lines on large trees — and can still resolve SUCCESS with exit 0. Cline's #13358 adds fail-fast error semantics by setting `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'` in the -Command bootstrap scope — first non-terminating error terminates with non-zero exit and single message. MODERATE priority: error-handling correctness (PowerShell failures should fail immediately with single message, not flood stderr + exit 0), medium complexity (~4h: update shellSpawnArgs PowerShell branch to set `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'` in -Command bootstrap scope instead of string-prepending into user script so param(...) blocks stay in first-statement position, test fail-fast semantics with malformed pipeline + access-denied junctions + stderr redirection, document tradeoffs in code comment: partial-result commands stop at first error, Windows PowerShell 5.1 stderr redirection may become fatal, per-command opt-out via `-ErrorAction Continue`). Pattern portable (PowerShell wrapper is in src/tool/tools/shell/id.ts, -Command bootstrap approach keeps user script byte-identical).
- **Source**: Cline PR #13358 "fix(shared): run PowerShell commands with fail-fast error semantics" (merged 2026-08-20). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13358. Fixes #13285 (malformed pipelines flood stderr). Sets ErrorActionPreference='Stop' in -Command bootstrap scope, documents tradeoffs, cites GitHub Actions precedent.
- **Category**: tools (bash PowerShell wrapper). **Size**: ~4h (update shellSpawnArgs PowerShell branch to set ErrorActionPreference='Stop' in -Command bootstrap, test fail-fast + tradeoffs, document precedent + opt-outs). **Priority**: MODERATE (error-handling correctness, medium complexity, proven pattern, GitHub Actions precedent). **Status**: NEW (2026-08-20).
